title: Mobility and Warm-Up: 8 Minutes That Save Your Knees
description: Skipping the warm-up and wondering why your knees hurt after squats? An 8-minute mobility routine that keeps you training for decades, not weeks.
excerpt: The warm-up isn't a waste of time. It's the insurance policy against the injury that sidelines you for a month.
content:
Most gym injuries don't come from heavy weight. They come from walking under the bar cold. Eight minutes of mobility protects your knees, hips and lower back — and it matches how the body actually works.

## Why static stretching first is a mistake

Passive stretching before lifting actually lowers your output. Meta-analyses show up to 5% strength loss after two minutes of static holds. You want dynamic mobility: full-range movement that warms the joint and wakes up the CNS.

## The 8-minute routine I run daily

1. **Cat-cow** (60s) — unlocks the thoracic spine.
2. **Hip circles** (60s per side) — your knees will thank you on squat day.
3. **World's greatest stretch** (2x5 per side) — hips, chest, ankles in one move.
4. **Band pull-aparts** (2x15) — wakes the scapula before pressing.
5. **Deep air squats** (2x10) — ramp-up to your working weight.
6. **Glute bridges** (2x12) — activates the posterior chain.

## Space to actually do it
